usedFor: Twilio holds your calls and numbers, and Conversion Chats follows up when “Send Template Message” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incoming Call” in Twilio, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A call to your Twilio number triggers a template message sent through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “New Message” in Twilio is polling, so a follow-up from it trails the message by one check.
